items.q: Which planet has the longest day (one full spin)?
items.fact: Venus spins once in about 243 Earth days, longer than its year.

items.q: Which hormone makes you sleepy once it gets dark?
items.fact: Melatonin rises after dark. Bright screens delay it.

items.q: Which moon phase comes right after a full moon?
items.fact: After full, the moon starts shrinking: waning gibbous.
